items: A **new** tag: the part is not there today.
A **was:** tag: the words that this place shows today.
“…” marks a number that the tool prints there, such as a task's number; it does not change.
**Where we are** (new): you see the release, the milestone and the task that runs now, at once.
**The state word on each card** (new): each card says its state in your words.
**The tag on a card** (was: ◫ Sage feel): it names the level and its number.
**The tab** (was: Programs): it starts at the top level and answers “how far is 1.0?”.
**The approval question** (was: Approve program …?): you see the name and the release before you say yes.
**The status lines** (new release line; “done” was “merged”): a study that ended counts too.

blocks.text: **What stays the same:** the six columns from Backlog to Done, the step line on each card, the order of the cards, your three answers (approve, change, drop) and the tool's own task states.

blocks.label: Goals
blocks.text: You see where the work stands in your words, at once.

blocks.label: Non-goals
blocks.text: Dates; new kinds of work. The tool keeps its own 15 states.

blocks.label: The choices, and the options I dropped

items: Where: a frame above the board's columns. Dropped: words on the cards only; columns by state word. Why: one picture, the same as the catch-up.
Word: milestone for a group of tasks. Dropped: program as a level above milestones. Why: they are the same thing, and program also means a computer program.
Storage: the logbook files use the new word too. Dropped: new words on screen only. Why: agents read the files, so the files must use your word.
Build: three pull requests. Dropped: one. Why: a rename of about 1,700 lines would hide about 500 lines of new rules from the reviewers.

blocks.label: Why we might not do this
blocks.text: It costs 10.5 to 21 M tokens and 13 to 26 h of agent time, and every logbook moves once to the new words.

blocks.label: Safety and cost
blocks.text: The move of the logbook is a one-time migration, so the route adds the security review. Cost as above (estimate, from the engineer's check).
